body: ${41:Describe the overall design language — brand values, visual principles, and the intended audience for this design system.}
${42:Document the colour palette, including primary, secondary, surface, and semantic colours (error, warning, success). Include usage guidelines for each.}
${43:Document the type scale: font families, sizes, weights, and line heights for each named text style. Explain when to use each style.}
${44:Document the grid system, column counts, gutters, margins, and the spacing scale derived from the base unit.}
${45:Document the shadow and layering system. List each elevation level, its intended use (cards, dialogs, navigation), and its box-shadow value.}
${46:Document the border-radius scale and the shape language it conveys. Explain the intent behind small (chips), medium (cards), and large (dialogs) shapes.}
${47:Document component-level token overrides. For each component, list the tokens it consumes and any composition rules that differ from the global defaults.}
${48:List the most important usage rules as bullet pairs. Each pair should have one positive example (Do) and one anti-pattern (Don't).}
